answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's whisper. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its yarrow from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each cipher has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 2x53h.
